extracted.name: Banana chocolate chip muffins
extracted.description: This recipe was submitted by a Good Food member and has not been tested by our team.
instruction_lines: Heat oven to 190 deg (170 on fan bake). Grease a 12 hole standard muffin tin or use paper muffin cups.
In a bowl add mashed bananas, sugar, melted butter, egg and milk and stir to combine.
Sift flour, baking powder and baking soda into banana mixture and stir to combine. Then stir in chocolate.
Spoon mixture into prepared pan and bake for 20 to 25 minutes.
